_DEMO_ROLE: Demo baseline — DEFAULT GNN+IMM tracker in tropical storm. First of the auto-tune demo pair. Designed to visibly struggle under 100 mm/hr tropical rain + mountain clutter, showing the performance floor before auto-tuning.
_DEMO_WORKFLOW: 1) runSingleScenario('tropicalStorm_default') -- generates fresh detections & baseline GNN+IMM track result | 2) autoTuneTracker('tropicalStorm_default', 'GNN') -- sweeps gate/volume/beta + IMM filter params on cached detections, writes config/trackers/autotuned/tropicalStorm_default/GNN_IMM.json | 3) runSingleScenario('tropicalStorm_autotuned') -- reuses cached detections, applies the freshly tuned params | 4) compareTrackers to show numerical delta.
description: TROPICAL STORM (baseline): 3 real NASA flights + mountain terrain + 100 mm/hr tropical rain. Default GNN+IMM tracker, no tuning. Expect heavy clutter, track swaps, elevated posRMS.
